title: Confirmed downloaded redirect override is a no-op
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Enable a downloaded redirect for redirect.example; open Redirected; turn its checkbox off and confirm Yes. Also invoke its contextual Move.
expected: The offered override creates an effective user exception or is unavailable with authoritative checkbox state.
observed: Source trace: the checkbox changes first; Yes calls moveListItem; REDIRECTED immediately returns without a write or refresh. Contextual Move is also offered and returns.
fix: Implement explicit redirect override semantics and hide unsupported Move actions; render checkbox state from completion.
test_evidence: Full scoped source/XML reads only. Proposed smallest regression: actual redirect checkbox plus Yes; assert override and row state; assert supported or absent contextual action. No runtime or test execution.

title: Canceling a downloaded toggle can make the next enable persist disabled
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Enabled downloaded block; turn off; cancel confirmation using Back without a reload; click the still-off row to turn on.
expected: Cancel restores current row truth and checked=true cannot persist enabled=false.
observed: Source trace: only the No button resets the visual state. Back leaves checkbox=false and entity=true; the next checked=true branch negates entity true to false.
fix: Restore visuals for every noncommitting cancellation and use an explicit desired-enabled operation rather than toggling a stale entity.
test_evidence: Full source/XML reads only. Proposed regression exercises actual off/Back/on sequence and outside-touch cancellation; assert no cancel write and final visual/entity/DAO agreement. Not run.

title: Mutation success is shown before completion and failures have no terminal state
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Hold diskIO; tap Block it for an unblocked fixture; observe early success; release the task with its first DAO write throwing a database exception.
expected: Success follows completed write/sync; failure restores controls and presents retryable error without claiming a protection change.
observed: Source trace: Fragment shows success immediately after enqueueing. ViewModel writes and reads have no catch/finally or error result; loading=false and refreshed result occur only on success. Process-level crash behavior is not asserted.
fix: Publish lifecycle-owned success/error results; reset loading on all completion paths; disable pending mutation controls; show success only after successful completion.
test_evidence: Source-confirmed only. Proposed smallest regression holds one mutation then injects DAO failure; assert no early success plus error and restored controls; retry; add read-failure reset control. No runtime/test execution.

title: Credential-bearing URL can target its username instead of its hostname
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Check https://account.example:secret@target.example/path then use Block it or Add to Allow List.
expected: Extract target.example from the authority or explicitly reject credential-bearing URLs; never mutate account.example.
observed: Source trace: scheme/path stripping leaves account.example:secret@target.example; first-colon truncation yields valid account.example. Result-domain actions use that wrong target.
fix: Use structured parsing for http/https authority followed by hostname normalization; separate bare-host input handling; reject unsupported authority forms.
test_evidence: Full source reads only. Proposed pure normalizer regression expects target.example or rejection; normal URL/port/IDN controls and checker wrong-target write guard. Not run.

title: Retained tabs display a stale query while sharing a newer filter
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Keep Blocked and Allowed views alive; search alpha in Blocked; search beta in Allowed; return to Blocked with alpha/beta fixture rows.
expected: The visible query always describes displayed rows whether search is shared or tab-local.
observed: Source trace: every tab writes the Activity filter and all streams observe it; each editor only copies the query at creation. Blocked retains alpha text while its rows use beta.
fix: Observe shared query into all live editors with a feedback-loop guard or make filters truly per-tab; keep hierarchy restoration from publishing obsolete text.
test_evidence: Full source/XML reads only. Proposed regression retains adjacent views and asserts query/row agreement through navigation and recreation. No runtime or test execution.

title: Background mutation refresh can replace a newer user filter
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Set alpha; pause a completing add/edit task after refresh reads its filter; on main set beta or toggle sources; resume background refresh and drain posted delivery.
expected: Mutation completion refreshes rows without undoing a newer query or source visibility selection.
observed: Source trace: diskIO snapshots the full filter then postValue publishes it later; newer main-thread setValue has no generation protection against the queued old snapshot.
fix: Rely on DAO invalidation if sufficient or dispatch refresh to main before reading current filter; avoid unversioned background copies of user state.
test_evidence: Source-only interleaving proof; no measured incidence. Proposed controlled-queue regression asserts newest query and sourcesIncluded survive mutation completion; same-filter control. Not run.

title: Accepted long wildcard line is silently skipped when adding allow rules
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: Allowed multiline input has example.com followed by 244 asterisks (255 characters) then control.example on a new line; press Add.
expected: Every accepted line persists or is rejected visibly before dismissal; add and edit use one length policy.
observed: Source trace: wildcard removal leaves valid example.com so dialog validation passes; ViewModel silently returns for raw length over 253. Control line alone is submitted; no rejected-line feedback exists.
fix: Share validation and canonicalization between UI and writes; optionally collapse repeated stars; surface rejected lines and align add/edit limits.
test_evidence: Full scoped source/XML reads only. Proposed two-line batch regression requires visible validation error or both canonical rules persisted; edit and short-wildcard controls. Not run.
